title: Booking {reference}
keepLink: Save this link: you can reopen it any time. We have also sent it to you by email.

status.paidDetail: Your booking is confirmed. We have emailed you the details.
status.paid_not_honored: We received your payment, but the booking could not be confirmed
status.paid_not_honoredDetail: Your payment arrived after the booking had expired or been cancelled. We will contact you within a few hours to refund you or book again; you don't need to do anything.
status.refundedDetail: The refund was sent to your payment method. It can take a few days to show up.
status.awaitingDetail: This may take a moment. This page updates on its own.
status.unpaid: Your booking is not paid yet
status.unpaidDetail: We hold your booking for 30 minutes. Pay the deposit to confirm it.
status.confirmedDetail: There is no pending payment online. We sent the details to your email.
status.failed: We could not take the deposit
status.failedDetail: Your booking is still held. You can try paying again.
status.expiredDetail: The payment was not completed in time and the dates were released.
status.cancelledDetail: No line of this booking is still active.

errors.payment_already_pending: A payment is already in progress for this order. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.already_paid: This order has already been paid.
errors.nothing_to_pay: There is nothing left to pay for this order.
errors.order_not_found: We could not find the order to start the payment.
errors.mercadopago_unavailable: We could not reach Mercado Pago. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unknown: The payment could not be started. Please try again.
errors.payment_rejected: Your payment method was rejected. You can try again or use a different method.
errors.pms_refused: The accommodation is no longer available for those dates. Nothing was charged and the booking was cancelled: you can look for other dates or another place.
errors.pms_refused_pending: The accommodation is no longer available for those dates. Nothing was charged and your booking will be released automatically within the hour.
errors.pms_release_pending: We could not confirm your booking with the accommodation. Nothing was charged and your booking will be released automatically within the hour.
errors.pms_unavailable: This accommodation cannot be booked online right now. Nothing was charged and the booking was cancelled.
errors.pms_unreachable: We could not confirm your booking with the accommodation. Nothing was charged and the booking was cancelled; you can book again in a few minutes.
errors.pms_claim_in_progress: Your booking is already being confirmed with the accommodation. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.pms_unknown_outcome: We don't know whether the accommodation managed to register your booking. Nothing was charged: try again in a few minutes.
errors.pms_unconfirmed: We could not confirm your booking with the accommodation. Nothing was charged: try again in a few minutes.

guestCancelHint: To cancel or change this booking, message the establishment.
